title: Divine Farmer Agricultural AI Model
summary: China Telecom reports agricultural Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. These technical capabilities do not establish yield or income gains.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Telecom reports agricultural Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. These technical capabilities do not establish yield or income gains. Reported accuracy rates concern model performance. The chapter does not measure changes in crop yield, farmer income, pesticide use, or environmental conditions.
purpose: Provide farming advice, pest identification, and agricultural market forecasts.
developer: China Telecom Wanwei Information Technology Co., Ltd.

ratings.reason: The source reports agricultural guidance and image-diagnosis capabilities, with Q&A accuracy above 90% and pest/disease recognition above 85%. The rating concerns access to a technical capability, not demonstrated crop or income gains.
Food security, lower chemical use, and emissions reductions are intended, with no measured field effects.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Divine Farmer Agricultural AI Model

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Agricultural question, image, and market datasets

headline: Divine Farmer provides agricultural guidance

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
